tool: Bowtie 1.3.1 (static binary), -v 3 -a: full-length ungapped alignments with up to 3 mismatches, all reported
index: bowtie-build over the four archived AgamP5 molecules (clean rebuild; first index was corrupted by an accidental concurrent build and failed its own-site sanity check - detected, rebuilt, verified on a synthetic index)
query: 23-mer protospacer+PAM units of dsx-v3-1, dsx-v3-2, kyrou
reading: Bowtie's -v 3 mode is semantically identical to the audit's bar (full-length Hamming distance <=3 over the 23-mer unit). It reports exactly three alignments genome-wide - the three on-target sites at the cross-assembly-verified coordinates - and zero secondary sites. This is the fourth independent confirmation of 23-mer uniqueness (aligner-free enumerator, NCBI BLAST+, minimap2 at block resolution, Bowtie), and the one whose semantics match the claim most directly.
